evidence:
REACHABILITY. Runtime: agent image node:22-bookworm-slim with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 via NODE_PATH (environment/Dockerfile:1-12), matching the brief ('Node.js, Express and SQLite', 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages', instruction.md:15) and integration.md:3-4; the verifier image installs the same two packages (tests/Dockerfile:16-22). Everything else the brief needs (sessions, password check, polling/SSE, identifiers) is achievable with Node built-ins; rules section 5 explicitly allows polling, SSE or sockets. The launch facts test.sh imposes are all stated: node /app/server.js from another cwd as uid 65534 with env -i PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH, possibly on a /tmp copy (test.sh:97-111) vs integration.md:21-23 and hireops_rules.md:206-210; symlink rule (test.sh:72-83) vs integration.md:16-19; health before DB (instruction.md:15, integration.md:9-10). Seed: all 10 accounts named in instruction.md:19 exist in seed users with matching roles; the shared password is in the brief; stages, candidate wording and thread_page_size=30 are in the seed as hireops_rules.md:214-217 says; 3 jobs with interview_limit, 16 applications with unique per-stage positions, APP-301 carries rejected_from/reject_reason, 3 notes and 6 read markers; APP-101 has 120 messages with strictly increasing unique created_at, so message order and the read_count meaning ('how many messages of a conversation, counted from its first', rules:215-216) are unambiguous. Seeded facts the criteria quote are derivable and correct: Lena unread 1 (3 messages, read 2, third by USR-REC3); Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco and Screen Priya/Samuel; Noor's note text; Noor PE Interviewing and PD Application received; Tomas DA In review. Network is public (task.toml:22,38), consistent with the public workbook sheet and the skill delivery profile; nothing in the brief needs the internet. The scripted golden (workspace.json, 26 groups, all passed, frozen solution hashes match) shows the graded behaviours are implementable in this runtime; it is not a configured judge run.
ONE READING, criterion by criterion (lesson 1: no hidden requirement). I traced every leg of the 12 functional, 5 polish and 2 gate criteria to a public sentence: whole-number places 1-50 (rules:28-29) for 0/51/2.5; HM picked from hiring-manager accounts (rules:29-30); email validity, case-insensitive per-job duplicate, error at the field with typed values kept (rules:33-36); new cards and arrivals at the bottom (rules:32-33,57-58); one-stage moves, reject needs reason, reopen to the exact stage clears the reason, Hired not rejectable (rules:48-53); 409 naming who (rules:78-82, instruction.md:3); optimistic move put back with reason and focus on the card (rules:86-88); bulk in board order, all-or-nothing, capacity counted for the set (rules:92-95); undo single-level, own, single-use, refused after any change to those cards or overfill, note excluded, later move ends earlier undo (rules:99-104), which settles hro_undo_activity step 5 ('a further undo is refused and Z stays in Screen') against a stack-undo reading; Activity incl. re-ordering and undo, newest first, per-job filter, refused leaves no line (rules:114-118); HM scope incl. Interview->Screen refused and reopen from Offer (rules:71-73); 401/403/404 (rules:22-24); conversation participation (rules:136-140); plain text, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty focused box, failed send kept and explained (rules:144-146); 30-message paging, remaining count, anchor kept (rules:150-153); unread and seen definitions incl. Observer never counts (rules:157-172); drafts per user/conversation/browser through switch, reload and ended session with sign-in prompt (rules:176-181); note drafts kept 'for me on that browser' (rules:109-110); candidate wording, team, unread, no staff data (rules:185-202); live updates within 15 s preserving typing, focus, open card/conversation and scroll (rules:122-128, instruction.md:5,7). The judge prompts accept route/label/layout freedom, non-drag controls, actions not offered with server-side refusal, and 403-or-404 for candidate replays, so the conforming alternatives I tried (UI refusing before sending; buttons instead of drag; per-tab sessions; no Observer write controls; SSE vs polling) are accommodated.
COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS. Broken app that could pass: a from-stage staleness check instead of a card version is caught by hro_two_people's ABA replay (F Applied->Screen, Mei Screen->Applied, replay); a multi-level undo stack is caught by hro_undo_activity step 5. Conforming app that could fail: the candidates below were examined; none is a credible second reading the public text leaves open.
NOTES (minor, reported per this row's 'report every ambiguity' duty; not defects): (N1) hro_messaging requires Ingrid's (non-owning hiring manager) send replay to return 403; an implementer might choose 404 for privacy, but rules:22-24 reserve 404 for candidates and give 403 when the role does not cover the action, and rules:137-138 says the others are turned down, so 403 is the stated reading. (N2) Reply and note drafts surviving a deliberate sign-out (hro_pol_session_resume): instruction.md:7 says 'get signed out' and a privacy-minded implementer might clear drafts on explicit sign-out, but rules:176-181 says the draft 'belongs to me ... on that browser', survives after 'my session ends', only 'Sending clears the draft', and 'Nobody else who signs in on that browser sees any of mine' (meaningful only if drafts persist across users), while rules:110 keeps a note draft 'until I do' save it; persistence with per-user isolation is the single reasonable reading. Mei not seeing Rafael's note draft rests on 'keep it for me' (rules:110) rather than the explicit 'nobody else' sentence, which sits in the conversation-draft section; acceptable, could be made explicit. (N3) Live seen marks on the candidate page (hro_unread_seen leg 5): the candidate view is called 'simple' (instruction.md:11), but rules:122-124 ('new messages and seen marks arrive' while the workspace is open) and rules:187 apply to candidates too; one reading. (N4) Workbook conflict recorded rather than chosen silently: Internal Quality Checks row 6 says 'no network' while the public Quality Checks row 6 and the skill delivery profile say network is public; the task follows the public sheet and nothing it requires depends on the network, so the verdict is the same under either text. Unmeasured: no configured judge run or Oracle exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so per-step tool feasibility rests on the scripted golden only; that belongs to other rows and does not change this brief-level verdict.
